label: From Ambitious Impact's welfare points (2018–2023) to days of disabling pain

rows.label: Days of disabling pain equal to one welfare-point-year

source.title: Charity Entrepreneurship, welfare points by animal (2018), 'Aggregate different animals' tab; Ambitious Impact's SADs for caged and aviary hens (facts: ace.caged_hen_sads_per_year, sad_factors.sads_per_hen_year_cage_to_aviary, aim_sads.chicken_2024); Vasco Grilo, Cost-effectiveness of the fish welfare interventions recommended by Ambitious Impact (EA Forum, 2024)
source.quote: Max score: 100 to -100. FF (aviary/cage-free) laying hens -39.29; FF (battery cages US) laying hens -57.14.
source.note: Grilo's post (https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/yoDTsrR95YRnBW6fk): "0.01 DALYs averted per WP (= 1/100), since a practically maximally happy human life" scores 100 a year. The bridge itself is ours.

rows.explainer:
Before 2024 Ambitious Impact (then Charity Entrepreneurship) scored an animal's welfare from −100 (the practically worst life) to +100 (a practically maximally happy one; a person in Canada scores 81, a caged hen −57, a farmed fish −44). A welfare point affected is one point of that score for one animal for one year, multiplied by Ambitious Impact's probability that the animal is sentient. Every species' scale runs over the same 200 points, so the points carry no weight for how much a species can suffer beyond the chance it is sentient. To rank these models we turn a welfare-point-year into days of disabling pain on the animal's own scale, then weigh the days by species like every other animal model.

Best guess, 2.1, from Ambitious Impact's own two systems on the same change: moving a hen from a battery cage to an aviary is worth 17.86 welfare points a year on the 2018 scale (−57.14 to −39.29) and 17.4 SADs a year in its later suffering-adjusted days (28.9 − 11.5), which with its 46.4% hen weight taken out is 37.5 days of disabling pain: 37.5 / 17.86 = 2.1 days per welfare-point-year. Low end, 1.09: the same comparison on the level rather than the change (a caged hen's 62.3 days a year over her 57.14 points below zero). High end, 9.09: Vasco Grilo's reading that 100 points for a year is one healthy year (0.01 healthy years per point), which at the site's 0.0011 healthy years per day of disabling pain is 0.01 / 0.0011 = 9.09 days; welfare points also count things that aren't pain (fear, frustrated behaviour, deaths), which SADs leave out. The bridge and its range are ours, not Ambitious Impact's.
